title: A connected review, from evidence to follow-up
description: Review the institution, check funding conditions, inspect market liquidity, then retain the evidence for the next review.

products.name: Undertow
products.owns: Market depth and size-specific exit evidence

capabilities.title: Keep missing evidence in the review
capabilities.description: Inspect source-dated changes, overdue fields and visibility gaps across tracked banks and lenders. Open the live review queue and its original disclosures.
capabilities.boundary: Review alerts require human assessment. They do not establish institutional safety or change model scores.

capabilities.title: Make the review repeatable
capabilities.description: Connect the Research Desk, schedule bounded research and retain source records with operating diagnostics and recovery guidance.
capabilities.boundary: Each source keeps its dates, rights and missingness. Operator checks do not establish customer adoption.

capabilities.title: Inspect changes before interpreting them
capabilities.description: Use NoiseFloor 0.3.1 to examine caller-supplied market series and headlines. Preserve measure identity, source restrictions and gaps.
capabilities.boundary: Noise analysis supplies research context. It does not grant feed rights, validate predictions or authorize a trade.

capabilities.title: Rehearse the controls around an action
capabilities.description: Explore the paper workbench: inspect refusals, duplicate protection, STOP and reconciliation before considering an execution workflow.
capabilities.boundary: The workbench is a simulation. Source permissions, freshness and account controls remain separate execution requirements.

limits: Coverage remains specific to each jurisdiction and market.
Funding conditions and market depth do not measure an institution’s deposit liquidity.
Release dates do not establish the freshness of source observations.
Evidence collection, delivery, validation and customer use are separate claims.
